ns2:section.sectionText: Non-Journalism majors that have been accepted into the PR Certificate program should visit https://illinois.edu/fb/sec/1773821 to indicate their interest in this and other required PR Cert. courses. Space is limited and seats will be granted on a first come/first served basis only. Students may not enroll in JOUR 200 and JOUR 210(formerly J 400) in the same semester. Please note: There are a specific number of seats assigned to each class level (Fresh.-Senior).
